name: Four Seasons Resort Punta Mita
positioning: Resort of Mexican-style casitas, suites and villas on a private peninsula in the Riviera Nayarit, 45 minutes from Puerto Vallarta
best_for: Golfers who want two Jack Nicklaus courses on site
Families who want a kids' programme (Kids For All Seasons)
Travelers who enjoy mezcal and tequila
Adults who want an adults-only pool

facts.text: The resort has 177 rooms in total.
The resort is located in the Riviera Nayarit.
The resort is on a private peninsula.
The resort is 45 minutes from Puerto Vallarta.
The resort offers accommodations in Mexican-style casitas, suites and villas.
Dos Catrinas serves authentic Mexican fare with a contemporary twist.
Bahía is a beachside restaurant serving freshly grilled meats, seafood and vegetables.
The resort has two Jack Nicklaus golf courses.
The Tamai pool complex is adults-only.

highlights.text: Tail of the Whale is the world's only natural island green.
Mez has over 70 varieties of mezcal.
The Punta Mita Tequila Stone massage is a signature treatment at Apuane Spa.
The Hakari Cultural Center offers a tequila blending experience.
Kids For All Seasons is the place for the youngest guests in the resort.

considerations.text: Puerto Vallarta International Airport is 45 minutes by car from the resort.
Fees apply for airport transfers arranged by the Concierge team.
The spa facilities are open from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm.
The Shack beachfront bar is open on select evenings.
WhataHotel notes the remote Punta Mita location requires planned transportation for off-resort exploration.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting exclusive resort positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, full breakfast for two is included daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
